comment: MCP server catalog for the agentic framework. One canonical definition per server, rendered into opencode.json (OpenCode) and configs/mcp.json (generic mcpServers clients). Secrets are always {env:VAR} references, never values. Verify consistency with scripts/verify.py.

brave-search.purpose: Web/news/local search. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY; disabled until the key exists.

context7.purpose: Documentation grounding: current, version-specific library/framework docs (Layer 4 knowledge). Tools: resolve-library-id, query-docs. Pin the version in the library ID - an unpinned ID answers for the newest release.

fetch.purpose: Fetch and convert web pages to markdown for the knowledge layer.

filesystem.purpose: Scoped file access. The path argument is the allow-list: never point it at a home directory root.

framework-knowledge.purpose: This framework's own MCP server (mcp/knowledge_server.py): hybrid RAG search + memory tools over a local corpus, demonstrating Lanham Ch 3 (build a server) and Ch 6 (memory/knowledge over MCP). Stdlib only.

github.purpose: GitHub issues/PRs/repos. Context-heavy (many tools) - keep globally disabled and enable per-agent (tool scoping) per Lanham Ch 4's context-cost rule.

memory.purpose: Knowledge-graph memory server (Lanham Ch 6): entities, relations, observations across sessions.

playwright.purpose: Browser automation via accessibility snapshots (Layer 2 actions; GUI-to-real-world work, Gulli App B). Snapshot mode by default; --isolated for sensitive work; runs with your OS permissions - treat as handing over mouse and keyboard.

sequential-thinking.purpose: External reasoning scratchpad (Lanham Ch 5's sequential-thinking MCP server): numbered, revisable thoughts for complex planning/debugging.
